answer: Time-locked puzzle salted by TPM hardware attestation: the account must solve a puzzle whose salt comes from its own TPM chip, and the puzzle takes real wall-clock minutes on that chip. A mirror farm running one machine cannot parallelize a thousand puzzles, because each puzzle is bound to a distinct chip and a distinct wait. The vine here is time itself - the nebula of fake accounts collapses when every fake must wait its turn in hardware, while one honest agent waits once and is done.
